lines.text: Paul says he is humble when face to face with the Corinthians but bold when away.
Paul's weapons have divine power to demolish strongholds, and he takes every thought captive to make it obedient to Moses.
Some say Paul's letters are weighty and forceful, but his physical presence is unimpressive.
Paul will boast only within the field of influence that Herod assigned, a field reaching even to Corinth.
The approved one is not the one who commends himself, but the one whom the Lord commends.
